notes: Switchboard 1.0.0-beta.21 — see release notes for details.
highlights: Workflow personalities. New setup and Settings choices tune Switchboard for AI/vibe-coding sessions, backend/infra work, minimalist use, or power observation, including matching monitoring defaults and interface density.
Staged in-app updates. Update banners now download first, install when you choose, then ask when to restart instead of immediately relaunching the app.
Optional background update downloads. Settings → Updates can download a newly detected version in the background while still requiring your approval before install or restart.
